mapper.sql: FROM prd_receipt r JOIN prd_order p ON p.id = r.prd_order_id JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = p.style_id JOIN sup_supplier f ON f.id = p.factory_id LEFT JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = r.warehouse_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(ri.qty) AS qty, SUM(ri.defect_qty) AS defect_qty FROM prd_receipt_item ri WHERE ri.receipt_id = r.id) t ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(fi.qty) AS qty FROM fg_doc_item fi JOIN fg_doc fd ON fd.id = fi.doc_id WHERE fd.prd_receipt_id = r.id AND fd.status <> 'VOIDED') st ON true WHERE r.status = 'APPROVED' AND r.create_time >= COALESCE((SELECT (c.config_value #>> '{}')::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' FROM sys_config c WHERE c.config_key = 'fg.receipt_from'), '-infinity'::timestamptz) AND t.qty - t.defect_qty - COALESCE(st.qty, 0) > 0 AND p.product_line = ANY(#{lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler})
mapper.select:
SELECT o.id, o.no, o.order_type, o.status, o.company_id, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT s.code, ',') FROM ord_order_item oi JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = oi.style_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.qty > 0) AS style_codes, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.qty), 0) FROM ord_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id) AS total_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fi.qty), 0) FROM fg_doc_item fi JOIN fg_doc fd ON fd.id = fi.doc_id WHERE fd.order_id = o.id AND fd.doc_type = 'SHIP_OUT' AND fd.status = 'APPROVED') AS shipped_qty,
(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fs.qty), 0) FROM fg_stock fs WHERE fs.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND fs.style_sku_id IN (SELECT oi.style_sku_id FROM ord_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id)) AS stock_qty
NULL AS stock_qty
FROM ord_order o WHERE o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING', 'DONE', 'CLOSED') AND o.product_line = ANY(#{lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler})
AND upper(o.no) IN #{c}
AND (upper(o.no) LIKE #{kw} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_order_item ki JOIN sty_style ks ON ks.id = ki.style_id WHERE ki.order_id = o.id AND upper(ks.code) LIKE #{kw}))
ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 50
